title: Bead aggregation assay to demonstrate the clustering of postsynaptic proteins by the NGL family of cell adhesion molecules
protocol: Transfect cultured neurons with EGFP-NGL-2 at DIV 14, and incubate for 2 days.
Mix 5 μg of biotin-conjugated EGFP antibodies with 2 μL of neutravidin-conjugated FluoSphere beads, and incubate for 1 hour.
Increase the mixture volume to 1 mL by adding Hank's balanced salt solution (HBSS).
Centrifuge the mixture at 13,000 rpm for 1 minute in a microcentrifuge.
Carefully remove the supernatant and resuspend the precipitates in 100 μL of conditioned media where neurons were growing.
Place coverslips containing transfected neurons (DIV16) face-up on 6-well dishes.
Add 100 μL of resuspended beads onto the neurons and incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Wash the neurons twice with HBSS and place the coverslip back into the culture media.
Incubate the neurons for 24 hours after adding the beads.
Fix and immunostain the neurons with primary antibodies against various synaptic proteins and fluorophore-conjugated secondary antibodies.
Capture Z-stacked images by confocal immunofluorescence microscopy as well as DIC imaging.
Manually trace the boundaries of the beads.
Copy a boundary to a nearby dendritic area for normalization.
Measure the average immunofluorescence intensity of a synaptic marker from a bead area.
Normalize the measured intensity to that from a nearby control area.
